company.name: Credal.ai
company.shortDescription: Build Enterprise AI agents for any chat surface, powered by your data and tools, subject to enterprise controls
company.description:
Our mission at Credal is to harness frontier AI for everyone building a better future.
We’ve built the industry’s highest ceiling and most secure Action & Agent building platform for sticky, custom AI workflows and we accelerate the most complex, sophisticated operations of the most impactful institutions, while weaving security and governance into every part of our product.
Use cases span countless domains, including: KYC, anti-money laundering, healthcare regulation, climate standards setting, cybersecurity, sales, people, IT, and customer support and our customers include the U.S. Dept of Health and Human Services, MongoDB, Comcast NBC Universal, Lattice, Wise (fka Transferwise), Checkr, and incident.io among others.

productsAndServices.description: A platform to build and deploy AI agents that integrate with enterprise data and tools while enforcing data security and access controls.
productsAndServices.name: Credal Secure AI Agent Platform

productsAndServices.description: Pre-built and custom connectors to integrate enterprise data sources securely with AI applications, supporting real-time synchronization and permission inheritance.
productsAndServices.name: Data Integrations and Connectors

productsAndServices.description: A system that synchronizes and enforces granular access permissions across all connected data sources to prevent unauthorized AI data access.
productsAndServices.name: Permission Synchronization and Access Control

productsAndServices.description: Automated detection and replacement of personally identifiable information (PII) with placeholders before data is sent to AI models, with the ability to restore original data afterward.
productsAndServices.name: PII Auto Redaction and Restoration

productsAndServices.description: Comprehensive logging and monitoring of AI interactions, including prompts, data accessed, and responses, to support compliance and security audits.
productsAndServices.name: Audit Logging and Compliance Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: A control mechanism that enforces explicit verification steps when AI agents perform actions crossing permission boundaries to prevent sensitive data leakage.
productsAndServices.name: Action Release Gates
